People: Alessandro Volta (author, Wikidata Q680), died 1827; Vincenzio Antinori (editor, Wikidata Q2526846), died 1865. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Volta, Alessandro, 1745-1827; Antinori, Vincenzio, 1792-1865 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Collezione dell' opere del cavaliere Conte Alessandro Volta, Firenze, Nella stamperia di G. Piatti, 1816, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/collezionedellop11volt_0. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 54%, 55%, 75% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Vincenzio Antinori, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
